posts.title: What the Hell Is Agile, Actually?
posts.description: Years in software development, a senior title, and I still couldn't tell you what Agile is. All I know is grab a Jira ticket, do the thing, sit through some meetings, repeat.

posts.title: I just finished RDR2 and somehow this is about Genshin
posts.description: Red Dead Redemption 2 keeps me caught up in its conversations and cutscenes. Genshin Impact keeps making me wonder when I can play again.

posts.title: Great power, no responsibility
posts.description: Everybody at work got the same superpower and almost nobody picked up the responsibility. Three stories about coworkers who handed the thinking over and forwarded me whatever came out.
